 Advertisement United Airlines experiencing 'widespread system outage' just days after nationwide ground stop
 Advertisement Updated: 5:35 PM EST Nov 16, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Brian Wiechert Digital Content Manager United Airlines experiencing 'widespread system outage' just days after nationwide ground stop
 Updated: 5:35 PM EST Nov 16, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Brian Wiechert Digital Content Manager United Airlines is experiencing a "widespread system outage," with at least some aircraft unable to take off.
 There has been no word on how many flights are impacted, or when flights will resume.
 Advertisement "We're aware of the widespread system outage, and our teams are working hard to get things back up and running as soon as possible. We appreciate your patience while we work through this," officials with the airline wrote on social media.
 A recording posted on the ATC app showed a United pilot in Houston asking the tower for permission to stay put at the gate until the system was working again. The app combines live air traffic control radio feeds with real-time visual aircraft tracking.
 Related video above | How the Trump administration is trying to prevent future travel disruptions after ground stop? 
 The latest airline issues come just days after the FAA halted U.S. departures for several hours after a communications and radar disruption affected air traffic control centers. 
 The agency said the stop was a safety precaution, and the outage led to thousands of delays and cancellations. Officials attributed the disruption to a router problem during routine maintenance on a telecommunications network, though the precise cause was still under investigation.
 This is a breaking news story and will be updated.
